summary.en-US: Local-first PDF reading and structured analysis workspace with outlines, notes, methods, annotations, and portable XML sessions.

version.approval_notes: Catalyst is a local-first Firefox desktop extension with no browsing or host permissions and no data collection or transmission. The Firefox package is a thin wrapper around the same production Vite build used for ordinary web hosting. A reproducible source archive is uploaded with this submission; see MOZILLA_REVIEWER_BUILD.md in that archive for build instructions, third-party source links, validator-warning explanations, and Firefox ESR 140.16 compatibility verification.

release_notes.en-US: Initial Firefox distribution release target for Catalyst 1.1.1.
